status: Derived theoretical solver cut; not implemented in the solver, no search run or actual Conway branch eliminated
context: Combines the majority flip theorem with a certified upper bound on labelled completions. It does not assert that a boundary with the required properties exists in every hypothetical Conway graph.

setup.parameters: SRG(1+2t^2,2t,1,2), with a fixed root and the canonical labels by its t star pairs
setup.instance: A partial labelled graph and any additional search constraints. Omega is its set of completed labelled SRGs.
setup.group: L is a binary linear subgroup of pure star-pair flips preserving the ENTIRE search instance, including all decided entries and additional constraints.
setup.forbidden_fixers: S consists of the nonzero elements of L of weight less than ceil(t/2). By the majority theorem, every s in S acts without fixed points on Omega.

small_support_subgroup.statement: If H <= L has every nonzero word of weight less than ceil(t/2), its action on Omega is free. Thus |Omega| is divisible by |H|, even when the completed graphs themselves have automorphisms.
small_support_subgroup.proof: A stabilizer in H cannot contain a nonzero element: such an element would be a forbidden pure-flip automorphism of the completed SRG. Apply orbit-stabilizer to each H-orbit.
small_support_subgroup.individual_flips: If r individual pair flips preserve the instance and r < ceil(t/2), their independent subgroup has order 2^r and every nonzero word has weight at most r. Hence |Omega| is divisible by 2^r.
small_support_subgroup.Conway99: Two preserved individual flips force a multiple of four completions; three force a multiple of eight. This is stronger for such a subgroup than the generic |L|/8 orbit lower bound.

two_completion_character_test.statement: If S is nonempty and the equations b dot s = 1 over F2, for all s in S, are inconsistent, every L-orbit in Omega has size at least four. Thus |Omega| is divisible by four.
two_completion_character_test.unknown: b is a vector of t binary coordinates. Every linear functional on L extends to F2^t, so these coordinates represent all relevant characters of L.
proof: An orbit of size one is impossible because any s in S has no fixed points.
On an orbit of size two, the action homomorphism L -> Sym(2)=F2 is a linear functional chi.
Every s in S must act as the nonidentity transposition, so chi(s)=1 for all s.
If the displayed linear system is inconsistent, no orbit of size two exists. Since L is a finite 2-group, every remaining orbit has size divisible by four.
two_completion_character_test.short_certificate: Inconsistency is equivalent to an odd collection of words of S having XOR zero. For example, s, u, s+u all in S form a three-word certificate.
two_completion_character_test.limit: Consistency only means this obstruction does not apply; it does not supply any completion.

solver_rules: Given a certified upper bound U on ALL labelled completions of the invariant instance, reject the branch if U < |H| for a subgroup H as above.
If the character test is inconsistent, a certified U <= 3 excludes all SRG completions.

For Conway, a boundary in the already established at-most-two-completions regime is impossible if it preserves two distinct individual pair flips. Their sum has weight two, so the three-word obstruction applies.
Separately, in the C1 asymmetric branch, any instance group L acts freely on the asymmetric completions. Hence U < |L| excludes all C1 completions, even if symmetric SRG completions remain.

spectral_connection.accepted_existing_bound: The existing coclique_rank_one_completion.py framework gives at most two labelled Conway completions in its certified residual-eigenspace-rank-at-most-one regime, including positive spectral boundaries of size 43 with their full cross rows fixed.
spectral_connection.peer_689: The peer's 49-row reconstruction criterion is conditional on the indicated restricted spectral rank being 44. That rank has not been established for every such configuration.
spectral_connection.full_rank_case: A certified unique completion (U=1) cannot coexist with even one invariant low-weight flip, since that flip would send the completion to a distinct one.
spectral_connection.not_claimed: No assertion that the rigid Gamma6 root skeleton is uniquely completable; no assertion that all 49-row configurations have full rank; no new global rank classification.

implementation_cautions: Preserving the root star or its transport skeleton alone is insufficient when other entries or constraints have been added: the group must preserve the entire instance counted by U.
Blocking only one labelled known solution may destroy the group action. Orbit-based cuts require an invariant blocking set, or an upper bound and action applied before that blocking.
The available Gamma6 root0 target has a rigid rooted skeleton, so these nontrivial local-flip cuts do not apply there.
No solver integration, timing improvement, or exclusion of an encountered branch has been demonstrated.
